# Fantastic Handyman

> > London's trusted handyman service for professional repairs, installations, and home maintenance with same-day availability and certified specialists.

Fantastic Handyman is a comprehensive home and commercial repair service operating across London and the M25 area. The platform connects customers with certified professionals including Gas Safe engineers, NICEIC electricians, and experienced carpenters for everything from emergency plumbing to full property renovations.
